sensor_models.status: PROTOTYPE; no human sign-off; physical pixel outlines are conditional fixtures

pixel.classification: INFERENCE of matrix size from DES-001 PM3-F01/PM3-I01; physical gaps/outline below are new NODD DESIGN CHOICE fixtures
pixel.source_locator: DES-001 PM3-I01; compact A3-I01; quad B-I20, B-I21, B-C22
pixel.fixture_note: Assume active matrices approach internal seam; 1.8mm die peripheral region lies at outer v edge of single/double and both outer v edges of quad. Matrix axes match chip-reference axes; no efficient seam collection assumed. Sensor gross area is active bounding rectangle plus guard, not chip silicon. Body includes approximate die periphery and extra service allowance; no assembly certification.

short_strip.classification: NODD DESIGN CHOICE inherited unsigned DES-007

long_strip.classification: NODD DESIGN CHOICE inherited unsigned DES-008

placement.classification: NODD DESIGN CHOICE — new unsigned numerical fixtures, approving humans pending
placement.description: Flat uses physical trial-body pitches and no staggering. Staggered uses active pitches and four alternating normal levels, half-pitch phi row shifts and quarter-of-overlap longitudinal/radial parity shifts. Tilted adds 12-degree rotation about local meridional axis; pint inclined normals stay as prescribed (no additional tilt there). Hybrid uses flat cylindrical barrels and staggered discs/inclined rings. No cropping at ideal or host boundaries.
placement.clearance_rationale: Additional clearance variants preserve controls; pixel discs use 4 phi colours times2 radial parity (8levels), phi counts rounded to colorperiod. Barrel spacing >= body thickness +2*(sqrt(r²+(body_u/2)²)-r)+0.2mm, conservative curvature shell separation. Same active dimensions, no added tilt; complete OBB SAT still required.

definitions.sensor_area: Gross physical sensor-face area, each sensor once; conditional pixel outline
definitions.active_area: Sum of readout islands, excluding seams and guards
definitions.station: Distinct station_id; long-strip requires a same-module complete pair
definitions.missing: Missing ideal eligible station IDs / total ideal eligible station IDs
definitions.all_hit: Fraction of eligible tracks with no missing ideal station ID
definitions.measure: Declared deterministic eta/phi/vertex grid plus seeded uniform off-grid sample; not event weights
